name: get_websites_charts
full_description: Returns visitor totals and chart data for the requested websites the caller can view, within the selected date range. Select a saved Umami host_id. Original upstream: GET /api/websites/charts.

host_id.description: Saved Umami connection ID. Obtain it from hosts_list.

ids.description: Comma-separated resource IDs. Provide between 1 and 20 IDs.

startAt.description: Start of the date range as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

endAt.description: End of the date range as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

timezone.description: IANA time zone used to interpret dates and group results, for example America/New_York.

period.description: Relative date range, for example 7d or 30day, used instead of an explicit startAt/endAt range.
